description: Declarative registry for the two top-level sk-design workflow modes. The advisor routes one sk-design identity and the hub resolves one registered mode from this two-mode registry.

discriminator.workflowMode: Public hub/mode key. Stable identity used by the hub router and this registry. Carried by every mode.
discriminator.packetKind: The axis discriminator; both registered design modes use 'workflow'.
discriminator.backendKind: Which backend runs the mode: reference-base for interface judgment or playwright-extract for the embedded CSS-extraction pipeline.

advisorRoutingContract.routingClass: How the advisor finds the mode. For sk-design every mode is 'metadata' = resolved by hub membership; the advisor routes the single identity sk-design and the hub picks the mode, so no mode carries an advisor map entry or a merged-identity projection.
advisorRoutingContract.grandfatheredFolderMismatch: true only when a registered packet folder differs from packetSkillName. Both registered modes use matching names.
advisorRoutingContract.command: The slash command bound to a registered mode.

transform-verbs.description: Declares the transform-verb routing extension: framing-split verb aliases (interface-frame 'make it' applies the move; audit-frame 'should it be' evaluates it), with aliasOnly carve-outs. Activates the in-place top-level transformVerbRouting block without relocating it — the hub router vocabulary, command projection parity, and playbook scenarios all read it at that location.

transformVerbRouting.note: Transform verbs are applied by the interface mode under the 'make it' framing. command-metadata.json's taskProjections is a separate layer governing which mode owns the same verb under an explicit slash command. The two intentionally name the same verbs for different resolution paths -- this is not a collision.
